status: Prepared but not executed; independent review and implementation freeze required before computation
analysis_status: Exploratory follow-up specified after all four release-model point estimates and local residuals had been examined; not preregistration or independent confirmation.
question: Uncertainty of twenty common-reference contrasts under four anchor releases and sixteen paired changes of original targets from AS01 S4.

data.missingness: Unchanged complete-case domain and full positive-weight variance frame; no new exclusions, imputations, weighting schemes or observations.

models.reference: AS01 S4 slope_adjusted; anchors i1 i4 i2 i3; 54 parameters
models.parameters: Accepted Q61 estimates unchanged; re-evaluate scores and Hessians at Q81 and Q121 without optimization.
models.structure: Same eight binary items, probit M2 affective/somatic factors, hearing/centred capped age/female coding, latent mean/variance/correlation specification, positive-loading orientation and parameter bounds.
models.release: Free hearing, age and female coefficients in the item intercept and log loading for exactly one specified anchor; retain every item and the other three anchors; attempt all four in fixed order.

estimands.direction: O1 minus O0. O0 means at least one ear detects all three 3-kHz tones; O1 means neither ear does. These are screening groups, not clinical diagnoses.
estimands.individual: At each observed age/sex, subtract O0 from O1 item-positive probability under a common standard-normal reference N(0,1), using each model calibrated item parameters.
estimands.probability: Phi(b/sqrt(1+a^2)); intercept b and positive loading a incorporate covariates and hearing.
estimands.average: tau_mj = sum_g (n_g/N) * sum_{i in g}(w_i f_mj(age_i,sex_i))/W_g. Use the same group-normalized weighted empirical age/sex mixture for every model.
estimands.paired: Delta_mj = tau_mj - tau_0j; model 0 is AS01 S4; paired targets are i5 i6 i7 i8.
estimands.units: Probability internally; multiply by 100 for percentage points.
estimands.interpretation: Paired changes measure sensitivity to anchor assumptions, including reference-calibration shifts; they are not observed prevalences, causal effects or amounts of bias removed.
estimands.excluded: No new age/sex profile tests, omnibus DIF tests, item deletion, best-anchor search, latent individual scores or treatment effects. Existing AS01 results retain their original sixteen-target multiplicity family.

joint_variance.method: Observed-Hessian M-estimator sandwich plus empirical-reference linearization; retain full cross-model covariance.
joint_variance.notation: s_mi is an unweighted individual negative-loglikelihood score; sbar_mg is its original-weighted group mean; U_m=sum_g(n_g/N)sbar_mg; A_m is the Hessian of the mean normalized criterion; J_mj is the target gradient at the observed reference distribution.
joint_variance.paired_if: IF_Delta_mji=IF_mji-IF_0ji for the same participant, then sum within the same household. Stack all five models and retain parameter/reference and model/model cross terms.
joint_variance.paired_identity: Var(Delta)=Var(tau_m)+Var(tau_0)-2Cov(tau_m,tau_0). Primary computation uses directly differenced influence arrays; verify by full covariance transformation. Never add independent SEs or use marginal CI overlap as a paired test.
joint_variance.design: Aggregate both hearing groups within household. Retain all 6217 households in the 8152-row frame, including 469 zero-domain households. Centre within 9 GOR strata; V=sum_h H_h/(H_h-1) sum_c(T_hc-Tbar_h)(T_hc-Tbar_h) transpose. With-replacement working-design approximation, finite-cluster correction, no sampling FPC, fixed final survey weights.
joint_variance.sensitivity_tie: lex_last for the same three mixed-GOR households; recompute all direct/paired covariance with unchanged influences and parameters; do not select rule by narrower intervals.
joint_variance.reference: Linearize group counts, within-group original weight sums, domain total and empirical age/sex mixture jointly. Previously normalized weights and reference distribution are not treated as fixed.
joint_variance.implementation: The per-model helper alone does not supply paired covariance. Keep all five models target influence arrays in RAM until constructing the cross-model covariance; then discard them.

intervals.family: Twenty direct targets and sixteen paired changes form one new family. Retain 36 if some fail.
intervals.bonferroni: estimate +/- t(1-.05/(2*36),6208)*SE; family-wise 95% under the stated asymptotic working-design inference.
intervals.reporting: Show pointwise and Bonferroni columns separately; no p values required; no clipping or significance-based model choice. This family does not retroactively control older AS01 inference or all previous exploration.
intervals.limits: Crossing zero does not prove invariance/equivalence; a paired interval excluding zero does not prove anchor invalidity or that another model is unbiased.

numerics.fixed_half_step: At Q81 for all five models, repeat Hessian with 5e-5*max(1,abs(theta_k)) and recompute all direct and paired SEs; no refit.
numerics.stationarity: Maximum absolute unconstrained gradient <=2e-4 at both quadratures; no parameter within 1e-5 of a bound.
numerics.hessian: Finite symmetric Hessians with minimum eigenvalue >1e-7 at Q81, Q121 and Q81 half-step; no pseudoinverse, ridge or eigenvalue repair.
numerics.raw_hessian_asymmetry: Before symmetrization, max absolute Hessian asymmetry <= 1e-7*max(1,maximum absolute Hessian entry); otherwise hold model.
numerics.score_identity: Max absolute difference of normalized individual scores versus analytic criterion gradient <=1e-10.
numerics.se_gate: Each direct and paired target: abs(SE81-SE121)/max(SE121,1e-8)<=.02 and abs(SE81-SE81half)/max(SE81half,1e-8)<=.02. SEs must be finite and greater than 1e-8 in probability units; hold targets below this resolution rather than claiming precise near-zero paired uncertainty. Save absolute differences and denominators to expose near-zero cancellation. Units are probability.
numerics.covariance: Finite joint covariance; maximum absolute asymmetry <= 1e-14 + 1e-8*maximum absolute covariance entry; minimum eigenvalue >= -1e-10*max(maximum eigenvalue,1e-16), without repairs; reported variance diagonals strictly positive.
numerics.paired_identity: At each Q/step, maximum absolute discrepancy of direct-difference covariance versus full joint-covariance linear transformation <=1e-14 + 1e-8*maximum absolute entry of direct-difference covariance, in probability-squared units.
numerics.newton_direct: At every Hessian evaluation, abs(J_mj*(-A_m^{-1}U_m))<=max(1e-5,.05*SE_mj), in probability units.
numerics.newton_paired: At every evaluation, abs(J_mj*(-A_m^{-1}U_m)-J_0j*(-A_0^{-1}U_0))<=max(1e-5,.05*SE_Delta_mj). Separate direct-target passes do not imply paired stability.
numerics.base: Re-evaluate the four AS01 S4 targets on the same framework for joint assembly/gates; preserve their earlier point estimates and published family labels.
numerics.hold_rule: Release a model five direct intervals only if its model gates and all five direct-target gates pass. Release its four paired intervals only if both model/reference gates and all four paired gates pass. Keep failures with reasons; denominator remains36. A joint covariance construction/identity failure holds all affected paired intervals.
numerics.stop_rule: No optimization, new starts, extra quadrature orders, changed anchors/estimator/sample, tolerance relaxation or numerical repair to obtain significance. Any further remedy requires a separate dated amendment before execution.

before_execution: Independent review of plan and future runner, including estimand, normalization, covariance and multiplicity.
Synthetic finite-difference tests of estimating equations and empirical-reference averages with household multipliers applied jointly to all models.
Synthetic tests for cross-group and zero-domain households, direct versus block-transformed paired covariance, highly correlated models, near-zero paired variance, and row permutation invariance.
Tests of base/model/paired failure gates, fixed family size36 and invariant point estimates under GOR tie sensitivity.
New computation directory; freeze reviewed plan, code, loader and passing checks before new real-data variance computations. Verify protected source hashes before/after.
future_outputs: 20 direct and16 paired rows, pointwise/Bonferroni limits, release flag/failure reason
All Q/half-step, Hessian, gradient, SE, covariance and Newton diagnostics
Labelled joint aggregate covariance and full tie sensitivities
Versions, source hashes, duration, completion log and aggregate-only figures
privacy: No real-data access in this plan-authoring stage. Later computation uses authorized local data with network disabled; no participant, household, pattern, influence-array or latent-score exports; RAM only.
limits: Conditional asymptotic working-design inference; no allowance for weight estimation, omitted geographic design, anchor-selection or complete-case-selection uncertainty. Numerical adequacy does not validate structure or anchors. Previous M1R/DWLS simulation coverage does not validate this MNLFA sandwich. No independent replication or empirical coverage calibration claimed.
